entities.summary: Frank Van Dun is a Belgian philosopher of law and classical liberal natural law theorist. He is associated with the law faculty of the University of Ghent. In 2013 he was awarded the Prize for Liberty by the Flemish classical-liberal think tank Libera!. Frank Van Dun was a philosophers & thinkers from Antwerp (b. 1947-02-22, Antwerp). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
